title: Ko Samet
text: **Grace’s corner** had a beautiful few days in Ko Samet - relaxing on the beach, going on jogs and drinking beers. There are no photos of Rushan, as he got a pretty bad haircut right before going to Ko Samet. When we went back to the same hairdresser to fix it, they clearly thought it was that I didn’t approve of his haircut (as I messaged them on WhatsApp asking for it to be fixed). So the whole time he got his trim, they were asking me if I liked it, how they should cut it and if I wanted it changed - while barely speaking to Rushan. The fix was successful and he looks very handsome (not that he didn’t before).
